answer:
Fiorello H. La Guardia was born on **December 11, 1882**.  At that exact time, the mayor of New York City was **William R. Grace** (in office from 1881 to 1882).  Grace’s term ended that year, and Franklin Edson would assume the office in 1883. 

So, the mayor serving when La Guardia entered the world was William R. Grace.
